scope: Human-operated real-device acceptance; no fabricated results

cases.title: Crew Self sign-in and mission isolation
cases.procedure: Authenticate, switch mission, verify no prior-mission measurements appear

cases.title: Role access denial and expiry
cases.procedure: Verify denied role links and server access; expire auth while open

cases.title: Real camera PPG capture
cases.procedure: Grant camera permission, collect actual sample, inspect quality and provenance

cases.title: Permission denied and device interruption
cases.procedure: Deny camera; disconnect/reconnect and ensure no fabricated measurement

cases.title: Airplane-mode encrypted capture
cases.procedure: Capture offline, refresh and confirm encrypted records retained

cases.title: Reconnect and duplicate prevention
cases.procedure: Reconnect and sync twice; confirm idempotency and audit trail

cases.title: Multi-tab contention and conflict review
cases.procedure: Open two tabs, attempt concurrent sync and inspect needs_review handling

cases.title: Ground Medical authorized snapshot
cases.procedure: Authenticate medical role and inspect mission-scoped snapshot

cases.title: Researcher small-cohort suppression
cases.procedure: Use fewer than 3 contributors or 10 events; verify suppressed RPC and audit

cases.title: Researcher aggregate and direct-read denial
cases.procedure: Verify coarse aggregate and probe direct table SELECT and snapshot RPC RLS

cases.title: Directional and baseline interpretation
cases.procedure: Verify only observed directional changes and matched context; no clinical claims

cases.title: Voluntary self-assessment confidentiality
cases.procedure: Complete checklist, refresh and verify session-only/no upload

cases.title: Synthetic versus live separation
cases.procedure: Verify four synthetic crew cannot write into real mission records

cases.title: Mobile navigation, accessibility and noindex
cases.procedure: Mobile keyboard/screen reader smoke test; operational routes noindex

cases.title: Independent signoff and source provenance
cases.procedure: Confirm eight pending gates and unapproved source rules remain inactive
